**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 22:19
- [FACT] User inquired about how UPS drivers save gas by avoiding left turns.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] UPS drivers follow a routing strategy that minimizes the number of left turns they have to make in order to save time and fuel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This strategy is known as "left-hand routing."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] UPS drivers make as many right turns as possible rather than left turns.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Right turns are generally faster and more efficient than left turns.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Left turns often require drivers to wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] By avoiding left turns, UPS drivers can save time and fuel and reduce the risk of accidents.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In addition to left-hand routing, UPS employs other strategies to save fuel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] UPS uses hybrid and electric vehicles to save fuel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] UPS employs optimized driving techniques to improve fuel efficiency.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] UPS uses advanced technology to improve routing and reduce fuel consumption.
